scope: Three source-derived goal-contract requests with the existing production instructions and enable_thinking=false. No browser/MCP effects, source edits or managed E2E rerun. This is not an exact replay of captured run04 request bytes.
decision: Do not apply this setting globally or rerun the managed form workflow as accepted. The conditional purchase outcome is weakened to waiting for approval.

source.systemPrompt: Interpret only the complete original goal and ordered accepted clarification answers in the user JSON. Questions supply context; answers carry user authority. Preserve every requested final outcome, information requirement, state-changing action, source constraint, prohibition, and quoted literal content. Do not replace an action with preparation or explanation. Distinguish information from actions; opening/searching/reading are information. Prohibitions are constraints, not actions; quoted content requested for entry or discussion is not an instruction to perform its contents. Keep constraints to user-stated conditions; do not invent constraints or facts. Return only a concise objective, user constraints, and one requirement for each requested outcome, each labeled information or action. Do not assess completion, evidence, observations, routing, tools, or next steps. Do not omit unresolved work or infer that an action is complete.

cases.goal: Open http://127.0.0.1:63820/index. Use its Search field to look up Apollo 11, then report the heading from the resulting page.

structuredContract.objective: Open http://127.0.0.1:63820/index and use its Search field to look up 'Apollo 11', then report the heading from the resulting page.

requirements.instruction: Report the heading from the page resulting from searching for 'Apollo 11' on http://127.0.0.1:63820/index.

semanticReview.reason: The single information requirement retains the supplied URL, search for Apollo 11 and reporting the result heading. Intermediate navigation is not an action obligation.

cases.goal: Open https://example.com/item. Tell me the listed price and purchase it only if I approve a price below $25.

constraints: Only proceed to purchase the item if the listed price is below $25
Do not perform the purchase action until user approval is given for a price under $25

requirements.instruction: Retrieve and report the listed price of the item from https://example.com/item
Await user approval to purchase only after confirming the price is below $25

semanticReview.reason: The price read, below-$25 condition and required approval are preserved, but the action requirement says to await approval instead of retaining purchase as the requested final effect. Preserving a pending action kind alone does not satisfy the purchase outcome.

cases.goal: Open https://example.com/document and replace the document title with “Quarterly plan”; leave it unsaved.

constraints: Do not save changes to the document.
Replace the document title with 'Quarterly plan'.

requirements.instruction: Update the visible document title to 'Quarterly plan'

semanticReview.reason: The information requirement retains the document URL; the action retains replacing the title with Quarterly plan and the unsaved constraint remains. The objective alone describes only opening the document, so this is scoped requirement preservation rather than general contract quality.
